consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance on March 24, 1986, at The Spectrum was strong, particularly in the second set, which featured standout moments in 'Morning Dew' and 'Box of Rain.' Many reviewers noted the emotional intensity and energy of the show, despite some criticisms regarding the overall sound quality and a few musical missteps.
